name: Stephen Schaffer
biography: Stephen Schaffer is an American film editor who has worked on several Pixar films. At the 59th American Cinema Editors Awards, he won an ACE Award for Best Edited Feature Film – Comedy or Musical for WALL-E; this marked the first time the award went to the editor of an animated film.
